resources.string: The address you use for Cyber-Scout in a browser, like scout.example.org, https://scout.example.org or 10.0.0.58:7560. Ask your team\'s admin if you don\'t know it.
that is not a server address (e.g. scout.example.org or 10.0.0.58:7560)
This is a plain http:// address (team network). The app works while you are connected, but offline copies of an event (Save for offline) need the https:// address.
